executed -- see ../PORTING-devbox.md.
denver original: five stages --
docker-with-tools    Ubuntu 24.04 container, everything below runs inside
uv-packages          python 3.12.3 venv (conan, pytest)
nvim-by-hand         one prebuilt release, downloaded/checksummed by hand
tools-from-internet  cmake 3.31.9 + arm-none-eabi 15.3 via conan
best-practices       the team's PYTEST_ADDOPTS convention
PARTIAL ANSWER TO THE DOCKER STAGE -- devbox is the only one of the five
tools compared that has anything here at all: `devbox generate dockerfile`
and `devbox generate devcontainer` emit a container built FROM this
config. The direction is the reverse of denver's, though. denver takes an
image you specify (ubuntu:24.04, with its apt packages) and relocates the
remaining stages into it; devbox takes the environment it already resolved
and packages that as an image. So it covers 'ship this env as a container'
but not 'this project only builds on Ubuntu 24.04 with these apt
packages'. Different problem, same word.
'nvim-by-hand' is the neovim line below. denver's version of that stage is
~60 lines across nvim/install.sh (download, checksum, atomic unpack,
idempotence), nvim/activate.sh (PATH) and nvim/nvim.env (the pins) --
written by hand on purpose, so doc/how-to.md can show what that job costs
right before showing conan doing it properly. Reading those three files
next to one line here is the sharpest single comparison in this port.
UNVERIFIED VERSION for gcc-arm-embedded -- same caveat as
